title: 川辺公園で秋を見つけよう
summary: 遊歩道と小さな広場で、季節を感じるおすすめ散歩コース。

cover.alt: 川辺公園で秋を見つけようのイメージ

en.title: Discover autumn at Riverside Park
en.summary: A peaceful walk with a riverside trail and a small open square.
en.html:
Our fictional Riverside Park has a relaxed walking trail, perfect for a family stroll.

Visitors can enjoy riverside plants and the changing colors of the sky through the seasons.
